why_ai: Billing and retention automate, but curation, supply buying and physical fulfilment persist.
why_clarity: Churn and cycles are measured monthly, but curation fit and churn reasons are fuzzy.
why_digital: Sold and managed online, but subscribers receive shipped physical goods.

why_ai: Choosing unrequested contents is a taste problem that preference models are learning to solve.
why_clarity: Delight with unrequested contents is subjective, though skips and returns give signals.
why_digital: Curation happens on screen, but subscribers receive physical boxes.

why_ai: Diagnosing first-cycle churn from recorded signals is an analytics task AI performs well.
why_clarity: Concrete, fixable churn reasons are checkable against retention within weeks.
why_digital: Order, survey and behaviour data analysed entirely on screen.

why_ai: Prompting skip, pause and swap is mechanical interface and analysis work.
why_clarity: Saved versus cancelled subscriptions are measured immediately per prompt.
why_digital: Account flows and prompts delivered entirely online.

why_ai: Payment retries and card updates are pure automation with no human judgment.
why_clarity: Each failed payment is either recovered or not, measured instantly.
why_digital: Payment events handled entirely in billing software.

why_ai: Consumption prediction for cadence is a well-posed problem software solves.
why_clarity: The right delivery date is defined by when the customer runs out.
why_digital: Managed online, but coffee, razors and pet food ship physically.

why_ai: Clean, repeated, joined customer data is ideal machine-learning input.
why_clarity: Repeated observations against known expectations give checkable patterns, though uses vary.
why_digital: Subscriber event data analysed entirely in software.

why_ai: Billing, plans and dunning are commodity SaaS machinery rebuilt easily by rivals.
why_clarity: Recurring orders and billing are codified and executed identically at scale.
why_digital: Subscription software sold and run online.

why_ai: Committing inventory months ahead for an unknown base is a high-stakes bet with supplier relationships.
why_clarity: Each buy is a forecast under uncertainty judged months later.
why_digital: Forecasts are on screen, but buying physical inventory runs through supplier relationships.

why_ai: Smoothing a self-made shipping peak is a scheduling decision software can make.
why_clarity: Peak capacity and overtime are measurable each cycle against a schedule.
why_digital: Planned on screen, but the output is physical warehouse throughput.

why_ai: Discount-driven save conversations are scripted and increasingly handled by AI agents.
why_clarity: Saves are counted per contact across many similar cancellation requests.
why_digital: Chat, email and phone retention handled remotely.
